common_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE seated classroom NPC turnaround sprite atlas, transparent alpha. Four separate drawings of THE SAME one character in a precise equal 2 by 2 grid: top-left FRONT, top-right BACK, bottom-left nose LEFT profile, bottom-right nose RIGHT profile. All show full body from head to shoes in the specified seated pose, supported by an invisible chair, thighs horizontal, bent knees and feet resting on floor. Maintain the SAME posture and body build in all four directions; comfortable natural teenage anatomy, not chibi. No furniture, no desk, no chair pixels, no environment, no labels, no grid lines. Leave generous transparent margins in each cell. Art: simple low-detail pixel art for a background student in the referenced game classroom, clear bold pixel clusters, two shadow tones, muted school colors, dark pixel outlines; small simple eyes, no sparkling highlights, no elaborate face or hair strand detail. Character must look like an ordinary Thai high-school student with an individual body shape and recognizable personality, not a polished protagonist clone. Clean genuine transparent background with zero scenery, glow or vignette. Referenced image is classroom STYLE AND SCALE ONLY; do not draw the classroom.
